FIELD NOTES / SALT & CANVAS

NOT JUST A PLACE. A PACE.

Coastal roots.
Our own frequency.

We grew up on the East Coast, surfing, skating, and playing music. Those days gave us good friends, a sense of freedom, and a place to feel at home.

Life took us into careers in software development. Sessions became less frequent, and time behind a screen grew. But the ocean, the concrete, and the music never left our blood.

Decent is our way back. Back to the things that make us feel like ourselves. Back to good company, a slower rhythm, and that familiar place of peace.
